title: Auric Harbor Digital
text:
Auric Harbor Digital

notes:
Lead origin: inbound self-serve signup (trial credits). Contact via in-app chat 2026-02-18 -> moved to discovery after AE outreach.

Summary: Auric Harbor builds a lightweight ecommerce post-purchase assistant (chat + automated order actions). Mostly public cloud, low-ops preference; wants Hosted API for fast iteration. They are in early discovery but already hit a blocking issue when trying to enable streaming + function-calling and using JSON-mode / structured output: multi-chunk responses are causing their client JSON parser to fail intermittently.

What customer reported (verbatim snippets):
- "When we enable streaming + functions, the client receives partial JSON fragments and our parser throws JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 204."
- "function schema 'order_create' expects order_id:int but we get order_id as string from LLM sometimes, breaks flow."

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-18: self-serve signup, credit applied, tried sample chat flow.
- 2026-02-19: hit parse failures in staging; opened in-app chat; support suggested disabling streaming as workaround.
- 2026-02-20: AE (Marissa) intro email + shared quickstart Node snippet (thread:1782938349).
- 2026-03-01: Diego (SE) joined call to triage; collected logs and sample payloads (fireflies ff_20260308_auric_harbor_call).
- 2026-03-08: Demo call recorded; reproduced intermittent schema mismatch where LLM returns numeric ids as strings in function args. Jira RDINF-4521 created to track server-side validation suggestion.
- 2026-03-12: Customer asked for POC to validate streaming JSON delimiting strategies and function-schema validation.

Technical details / requirements:
- Workload: chat assistant that triggers backend order actions via function/tool-calls. Latency target: sub-300ms tail for single-user interactive flows; throughput modest (peak ~30 concurrent users). Cost sensitive: wants to keep token costs low (smaller context preferred).
- Problems observed: streaming chunks split JSON objects across chunks; their client concatenates chunks and calls JSON.parse prematurely. Also occasional type mismatches for function params (string vs int).
- Desired features: strict structured-output mode (single JSON object per response), optional schema enforcement server-side (reject or coerce types), guidance on streaming delimiter / chunk framing, sample SDK usage patterns to avoid parse errors.

Customer quotes / sentiment: "We love how fast initial replies are, but reliability of function payloads is a must — if order_create fails we have to fall back to email." CTO worried about user trust.

Proposed POC (agreed on call):
1) Redwood SE to produce a tiny POC: two endpoints (chat streaming with function calls) that reproduce parse error using their Node client and a minimal Python webhook that asserts typed params.
2) Test alternatives: (a) streaming with explicit chunk delimiter () and client-side streaming-JSON-accumulator pattern, (b) non-streaming single-payload JSON mode.
3) Enable server-side schema validation flag in POC environment (if available) or advise on best-effort validation in middle-tier.
4) Deliver a short doc + code snippets and a Drive link to POC artifacts.

Immediate next steps: Diego to send sample Node + Python snippets and invite for POC session (target week of 2026-03-22). Marissa to circulate internal pricing ballpark (linked PRICING deck).

Open questions / risks:
- Will Hosted API support strict server-side coercion/validation soon or is that only available for Private customers? (customer prefers hosted).
- Budget: current estimate ~$5-20k ARR but needs sign-off; cost sensitivity could push them to look at competitors.

Attachments / references: pricing and security deck in Drive, fireflies call id, Jira: RDINF-4521 for suggested schema validation.

Short-term workaround recommended to customer: disable streaming for critical function-calls or implement streaming buffer that waits for complete JSON object (use chunk delimiter  or newline + length-prefix). Diego sent example buffer util on call.

Notes logged by: Marissa Chen (AE) + Diego Morales (SE) on 2026-03-12.

blockers:
streaming JSON parse errors in client
function schema mismatch (order_create)
lack of internal dev time for integration
unclear cost on tokenized billing

next_step:
Schedule 45m POC call to reproduce streaming JSON parse + function schema mismatch and provide sample Node/py snippets; send POC invite and Drive link
